title: Learn the Deal
text:
We begin by determining who is East by rolling the dice. The tiles are dealt from East’s wall first. This will rotate each round.
Read through these steps for how the deal works, then try it yourself in the interactive game below.

East will roll the dice to break the wall (this is like cutting the deck in cards). You break the wall by counting the number rolled from the right side of the wall. These tiles are left behind, you then “push” the remaining tiles in wall forward and deal from those.
East takes the first tiles and then the deal continues counter-clockwise. Each player takes two stacks of tiles (4 titles total) until all players have 12 tiles
After the final player (North) has 12 tiles, East takes the first and third tile from the top of the wall – they will now have 14 tiles. Then the remaining players each take 1 tile, they will each have 13 tiles.

title: Building the Wall
text:
At the start of the game all 152 tiles are in the center of the table face down. Each player builds their own wall of tiles in front of their position. The wall consists of:

19 tiles across - placed end to end in a line

2 tiles high - each stack is two tiles tall

38 tiles total per wall (19 × 2)

All tiles are placed face down so no one can see what they are.
